defect: walk_sequence_expression pushed each comma sub-expression onto statement_path, misclassifying sequence sub-expressions as statement-level in parser plugins.
APIPlugin evaluated exports/typeof exports even inside strict ESM/harmony modules where exports is not a CJS free variable.
CssUrlDependencyTemplate used only global output.publicPath instead of the per-rule asset generator publicPath stored in CodeGenerationDataFilename.
PxToRem::visit_mut_length skipped normalizing px values below min_pixel_value without matching postcss-pxtorem's fallback unit/value formatting.
JsAssetInfo commented out fullhash conversion when renaming hash fields, dropping full_hash metadata needed by RealContentHashPlugin.
Compiler::emit_assets cached emitted asset versions in a DashMap without reconciling removed assets, preventing output.clean from deleting stale *.hot-update.js files.
Algo::global() and Algo::sticky() hit unreachable!() for Algo::EndWith when ContextModule regex validation queried those flags.
CssLoadingRuntimeModule emitted all initial chunks into installedCssChunks without separating initial chunks containing CSS from JS-only initial chunks.
CommonJsExportScanner evaluated typeof module and typeof exports to 'object' regardless of module type or local bindings.
ExternalModule::get_module_import_type panicked via .expect() when a module-import external was created for a dependency whose dependency_meta.external_type was None.
